checker_limits_found: A quote taken from a What's New API snapshot must start and end inside a paragraph (a sentence that begins after a full stop and a space, and ends before a space). Paragraph-first and paragraph-last sentences are rejected.
In guide bullets with a bold label and a dash ('Label - Sentence'), only the second and later sentences can be quoted.
Quotes that cross a Markdown link or an HTML anchor are rejected, so many one-sentence statements in the Well-Architected HTML tables and in link-heavy paragraphs could not be quoted.
